behaviors.semantics: Up to two power cuts over all objects in one volume. Completed successful sync fences survive. An unfenced append may retain any byte-prefix, including zero or all bytes; previously fenced untouched bytes cannot change. No record-atomic append assumption. Same-filesystem rename is atomic live; unfenced namespace changes admit old/new states, while directory sync persists preceding changes. Independent objects retain distinct identities. This is a declared logical profile, not native filesystem qualification; no spontaneous corruption.
Independently runnable native implementation tasks retain shared state and real synchronization; observation must not add serialization.

recovery: Faults cease; restart through ordinary Pebble Open and its real manifest/WAL/table recovery paths. Complete recovery within 100000 enabled operation/task selections; budget exhaustion without qualified progress is INCONCLUSIVE. Validate the retained sync-acknowledged key/value ledger, not a surrogate manifest parser alone.
exclusions: full production service transport/framing outside the stated module boundary
